Roles and permissions

Partner leads update capacity at their site. Assigned teams share availability and staff-only messages. Duty coordinators see all participating sites.

Build prompt

Build “Outreach & Crisis Response Live Board” on NeoApps for a nonprofit. Timestamp each update and flag stale data. Include reconnect and conflict handling. Keep locations of individual clients and staff chat private, and provide an existing dispatch contact for urgent escalation. Partner leads update capacity at their site. Assigned teams share availability and staff-only messages. Duty coordinators see all participating sites. Use fictional records for the demo.

Acceptance test

In two signed-in sessions a shelter lead changes 6 beds to 4. The coordinator sees 4 without refresh. Disconnect the coordinator, make another update, and confirm reconnect shows the newest count and timestamp.
